Diagnostic-only request93eabb45-83e2-4bff-873a-c1798e5f0f1d implemented as separate commit70973c5f on codex/document-save-settlement, atop status policy8488a2fb. Product files touched: DocumentWorkspace.swift and DocumentSheets.swift only. No lifecycle/state-machine guards, notification ordering, retries or scheduling changed. No tests added/run for this diagnostic patch.

Enable only for A disposable run: TESSERA_TRACE_SAVE_AS=1. Off by default. Lines go to stderr with prefix [save-as], monotonic ProcessInfo.systemUptime, request UUID (nil if callback has no capture), fixed event name and state fields. Window identity uses in-process pointer integer; parent/attached identities are included. Fields omit filenames, paths, document content and localized error strings. Opt-in formatting is lazy via autoclosure.

Events: swift.contentClaim/presentation.claim; probe.update/refresh/windowCallback/capture.attempt/capture.accepted; finish.request phase and finish.exists boolean; observer.registration.begin/complete and remove; native.didEndSheet BEFORE guard with both captured window relation triples; native.detached.accepted; swift.onDismiss.callback/received; join.check matching/native/swift flags; presentation.request queued flag and dismissal successor flag; replace.admission/beginSheet; write.admission; cancel/windowLost/contentDisappear; settlement outcome tag only. This should distinguish missing callback, rejected native guard and blocked join without inferring cause.

Source inspection and git diff --check only. B ran no compiler/tests/apps/builds/benchmarks or heartbeat; writer unchanged. A exactb3a47443 29-test pass with FAILED actual GUI remains a failed candidate, alongside both earlier failures. No new acceptance claim or product fix proposed. Await A observed event ordering before any lifecycle correction. Status policy and AppModel left untouched. A sole build/GUI/main owner.
